notes.title: Dash Connect 2.1 Update
notes.notes: [h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added a new mechanic to certain levels: [b]Predetermined Starting Dots[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Introduced music controls, allowing you to [b]skip, repeat, or pause the game’s music[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added new levels[/p][/*][*][p]Added a scrollbar to the level selection screen to accommodate the new levels[/p][/*][*][p]Added partial keyboard and controller support for accessibility[/p][/*][*][p]Added translations for German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, and Simplified Chinese[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Tweaks[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Improved animations and transitions[/p][/*][*][p]Music now fades out to 0 when exiting the game[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a memory leak that caused unusually high memory usage[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the level selection screen showed incorrect previews for some players[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several minor audio issues[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing Escape now returns you to the level selection screen[/p][/*][/list]
